name: design-build-checks
description: Quality checks for this design system: render + axe harness, the motion check, the DTCG tokens check, and react/react-dom for the component wrapper self-tests. lint.mjs and the components need none of these dependencies.

scripts.check: node test/run.mjs && node lint.mjs && npm run tokens:check && node render.mjs
scripts.postinstall: echo 'Next: npx playwright install chromium (add --with-deps on Linux CI)'
